On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.en: On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar fills on the battle results screen.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.ja: オン。戦闘結果画面で経験値バーが伸びる間、速いカチカチ音が鳴ります。
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.fr: Activé. Un tic-tac rapide retentit pendant que la barre d'EXP se remplit sur l'écran des résultats de combat.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.it: Attivato. Un ticchettio rapido suona mentre la barra EXP si riempie nella schermata dei risultati.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.de: Ein. Ein schnelles Ticken ertönt, während sich die EXP-Leiste im Kampfergebnis-Bildschirm füllt.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.es: Activado. Se oye un tictac rápido mientras la barra de EXP se llena en la pantalla de resultados.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.ko: 켜짐. 전투 결과 화면에서 경험치 막대가 차는 동안 빠른 틱 소리가 납니다.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.zht: 開啟。在戰鬥結果畫面經驗值條增長時，會播放快速的滴答聲。
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.zhc: 开启。在战斗结果画面经验值条增长时，会播放快速的滴答声。
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.ru: Вкл. Пока полоса опыта заполняется на экране итогов боя, звучит быстрое тиканье.
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.th: เปิด. เสียงติ๊กเร็วจะดังขณะแถบ EXP เพิ่มขึ้นในหน้าจอผลการต่อสู้
On. A rapid tick plays while the EXP bar.pt: Ligado. Um tique rápido toca enquanto a barra de EXP se enche na tela de resultados.

Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.en: Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the battle results screen.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.ja: オフ。戦闘結果画面で経験値バーは無音で伸びます。
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.fr: Désactivé. La barre d'EXP se remplit en silence sur l'écran des résultats de combat.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.it: Disattivato. La barra EXP si riempie in silenzio nella schermata dei risultati.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.de: Aus. Die EXP-Leiste füllt sich im Kampfergebnis-Bildschirm lautlos.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.es: Desactivado. La barra de EXP se llena en silencio en la pantalla de resultados.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.ko: 꺼짐. 전투 결과 화면에서 경험치 막대가 소리 없이 찹니다.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.zht: 關閉。在戰鬥結果畫面經驗值條會無聲增長。
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.zhc: 关闭。在战斗结果画面经验值条会无声增长。
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.ru: Выкл. Полоса опыта заполняется на экране итогов боя без звука.
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.th: ปิด. แถบ EXP จะเพิ่มขึ้นอย่างเงียบ ๆ ในหน้าจอผลการต่อสู้
Off. The EXP bar fills silently on the b.pt: Desligado. A barra de EXP se enche silenciosamente na tela de resultados.

Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.en: Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to one hundred percent.
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.ja: 経験値カウント音の音量。0から100パーセント。
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.fr: Volume du tic du compteur d'EXP, de zéro à cent pour cent.
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.it: Volume del ticchettio del contatore EXP, da zero a cento percento.
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.de: Lautstärke des EXP-Zähler-Tickens, null bis einhundert Prozent.
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.es: Volumen del tic del contador de EXP, de cero a cien por ciento.
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.zht: 經驗值計數滴答聲的音量，零到一百百分比。
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.zhc: 经验值计数滴答声的音量，零到一百百分比。
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.ru: Громкость тиканья счётчика опыта, от нуля до ста процентов.
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.th: ระดับเสียงติ๊กของตัวนับ EXP ตั้งแต่ศูนย์ถึงหนึ่งร้อยเปอร์เซ็นต์
Volume of the EXP counter tick, zero to.pt: Volume do tique do contador de EXP, de zero a cem por cento.

On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.en: On. Audio beacon is the primary navigation aid; turn-by-turn pathfinding is disabled.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.ja: オン。オーディオビーコンが主なナビゲーション手段になり、ターンごとの経路案内は無効になります。
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.fr: Activé. La balise audio est l'aide à la navigation principale ; le guidage pas à pas est désactivé.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.it: Attivato. Il segnale audio è l'aiuto alla navigazione principale; la guida passo passo è disattivata.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.de: Ein. Das Audiosignal ist die primäre Navigationshilfe; die schrittweise Wegführung ist deaktiviert.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.es: Activado. La baliza de audio es la ayuda de navegación principal; el guiado paso a paso está desactivado.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.ko: 켜짐. 오디오 비콘이 기본 내비게이션 보조 수단이 되며, 단계별 경로 안내는 비활성화됩니다.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.zht: 開啟。音訊信標為主要導航輔助；逐步路徑導引將停用。
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.zhc: 开启。音频信标为主要导航辅助；逐步路径导引将停用。
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.ru: Вкл. Звуковой маяк — основное средство навигации; пошаговый поиск пути отключён.
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.th: เปิด. บีคอนเสียงเป็นตัวช่วยนำทางหลัก และการนำทางทีละขั้นจะถูกปิด
On. Audio beacon is the primary navigati.pt: Ligado. A baliza de áudio é o principal auxílio de navegação; a orientação passo a passo é desativada.

Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.en: Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used for navigation.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.ja: オフ。ナビゲーションにはターンごとの経路案内が使われます。
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.fr: Désactivé. Le guidage pas à pas est utilisé pour la navigation.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.it: Disattivato. Per la navigazione si usa la guida passo passo.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.de: Aus. Für die Navigation wird die schrittweise Wegführung verwendet.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.es: Desactivado. Se usa el guiado paso a paso para la navegación.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.ko: 꺼짐. 내비게이션에는 단계별 경로 안내가 사용됩니다.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.zht: 關閉。導航將使用逐步路徑導引。
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.zhc: 关闭。导航将使用逐步路径导引。
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.ru: Выкл. Для навигации используется пошаговый поиск пути.
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.th: ปิด. ใช้การนำทางทีละขั้นสำหรับการนำทาง
Off. Turn-by-turn pathfinding is used fo.pt: Desligado. A orientação passo a passo é usada para a navegação.

On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.en: On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (auto-dash and encounter toggle). Mod functions move to mod mode.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.ja: オン。L3とR3はゲームに渡されます（オートダッシュとエンカウント切替）。Mod機能はModモードに移ります。
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.fr: Activé. L3 et R3 sont transmis au jeu (course auto et bascule des rencontres). Les fonctions du mod passent en mode mod.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.it: Attivato. L3 e R3 vengono passati al gioco (corsa automatica e attivazione incontri). Le funzioni del mod passano alla modalità mod.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.de: Ein. L3 und R3 werden an das Spiel weitergegeben (Auto-Sprint und Begegnungs-Umschaltung). Mod-Funktionen wechseln in den Mod-Modus.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.es: Activado. L3 y R3 pasan al juego (carrera automática y alternar encuentros). Las funciones del mod pasan al modo mod.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.ko: 켜짐. L3와 R3가 게임으로 전달됩니다(자동 달리기 및 인카운터 전환). 모드 기능은 모드 모드로 이동합니다.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.zht: 開啟。L3與R3會傳遞給遊戲（自動奔跑與遭遇切換）。Mod功能將移至Mod模式。
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.zhc: 开启。L3与R3会传递给游戏（自动奔跑与遭遇切换）。Mod功能将移至Mod模式。
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.ru: Вкл. L3 и R3 передаются игре (авто-бег и переключение встреч). Функции мода переходят в режим мода.
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.th: เปิด. L3 และ R3 จะส่งต่อไปยังเกม (วิ่งอัตโนมัติและสลับการเผชิญหน้า) ฟังก์ชันม็อดจะย้ายไปยังโหมดม็อด
On. L3 and R3 pass through to the game (.pt: Ligado. L3 e R3 são repassados ao jogo (corrida automática e alternar encontros). As funções do mod passam para o modo mod.

Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.en: Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 toggles pathfinding filter; game cannot see them.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.ja: オフ。L3はビーコンナビゲーションを切替、R3は経路探索フィルターを切替します。ゲームはこれらを認識しません。
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.fr: Désactivé. L3 bascule la navigation par balise ; R3 bascule le filtre de recherche de chemin ; le jeu ne les voit pas.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.it: Disattivato. L3 attiva/disattiva la navigazione con segnale; R3 attiva/disattiva il filtro di ricerca percorso; il gioco non li rileva.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.de: Aus. L3 schaltet die Signal-Navigation um; R3 schaltet den Wegfindungsfilter um; das Spiel erkennt sie nicht.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.es: Desactivado. L3 alterna la navegación por baliza; R3 alterna el filtro de búsqueda de rutas; el juego no los detecta.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.ko: 꺼짐. L3는 비콘 내비게이션을, R3는 경로 탐색 필터를 전환합니다. 게임은 이를 인식하지 못합니다.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.zht: 關閉。L3切換信標導航；R3切換尋路篩選；遊戲無法偵測到它們。
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.zhc: 关闭。L3切换信标导航；R3切换寻路筛选；游戏无法检测到它们。
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.ru: Выкл. L3 переключает навигацию по маяку; R3 переключает фильтр поиска пути; игра их не видит.
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.th: ปิด. L3 สลับการนำทางด้วยบีคอน; R3 สลับตัวกรองการหาเส้นทาง; เกมจะไม่รับรู้ปุ่มเหล่านี้
Off. L3 toggles beacon navigation; R3 to.pt: Desligado. L3 alterna a navegação por baliza; R3 alterna o filtro de busca de caminho; o jogo não os detecta.

On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.en: On. Descriptions and stats announce automatically on focus for items, magic, equipment, and shops.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.ja: オン。アイテム、魔法、装備、ショップで、フォーカス時に説明とステータスを自動でアナウンスします。
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.fr: Activé. Les descriptions et statistiques sont annoncées automatiquement à la sélection pour les objets, la magie, l'équipement et les boutiques.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.it: Attivato. Descrizioni e statistiche vengono annunciate automaticamente alla selezione per oggetti, magie, equipaggiamento e negozi.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.de: Ein. Beschreibungen und Werte werden bei Fokus automatisch für Gegenstände, Magie, Ausrüstung und Läden angesagt.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.es: Activado. Las descripciones y estadísticas se anuncian automáticamente al enfocar objetos, magia, equipo y tiendas.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.ko: 켜짐. 아이템, 마법, 장비, 상점에서 포커스 시 설명과 능력치를 자동으로 안내합니다.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.zht: 開啟。在道具、魔法、裝備與商店中，聚焦時自動播報說明與數值。
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.zhc: 开启。在道具、魔法、装备与商店中，聚焦时自动播报说明与数值。
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.ru: Вкл. Описания и характеристики озвучиваются автоматически при выборе предметов, магии, снаряжения и в магазинах.
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.th: เปิด. คำอธิบายและค่าสถานะจะถูกประกาศโดยอัตโนมัติเมื่อโฟกัสที่ไอเทม เวทมนตร์ อุปกรณ์ และร้านค้า
On. Descriptions and stats announce auto.pt: Ligado. Descrições e atributos são anunciados automaticamente ao focar itens, magias, equipamentos e lojas.

Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.en: Off. Use the I key to read descriptions on demand.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.ja: オフ。Iキーで必要なときに説明を読み上げます。
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.fr: Désactivé. Utilisez la touche I pour lire les descriptions à la demande.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.it: Disattivato. Usa il tasto I per leggere le descrizioni su richiesta.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.de: Aus. Mit der I-Taste werden Beschreibungen bei Bedarf vorgelesen.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.es: Desactivado. Usa la tecla I para leer las descripciones cuando quieras.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.ko: 꺼짐. I 키를 눌러 필요할 때 설명을 읽습니다.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.zht: 關閉。需要時按I鍵讀出說明。
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.zhc: 关闭。需要时按I键读出说明。
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.ru: Выкл. Нажмите клавишу I, чтобы прочитать описание при необходимости.
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.th: ปิด. ใช้ปุ่ม I เพื่ออ่านคำอธิบายเมื่อต้องการ
Off. Use the I key to read descriptions.pt: Desligado. Use a tecla I para ler as descrições quando quiser.

On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.en: On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks the current destination.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.ja: オン。ビーコンを再開すると、現在の目的地も再度読み上げます。
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.fr: Activé. Redémarrer la balise réannonce aussi la destination actuelle.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.it: Attivato. Riavviando il segnale viene riannunciata anche la destinazione attuale.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.de: Ein. Beim Neustart des Signals wird auch das aktuelle Ziel erneut angesagt.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.es: Activado. Reiniciar la baliza también vuelve a anunciar el destino actual.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.ko: 켜짐. 비콘을 다시 시작하면 현재 목적지도 다시 안내합니다.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.zht: 開啟。重新啟動信標時也會再次播報目前的目的地。
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.zhc: 开启。重新启动信标时也会再次播报当前的目的地。
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.ru: Вкл. При перезапуске маяка также повторно озвучивается текущий пункт назначения.
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.th: เปิด. การเริ่มบีคอนใหม่จะประกาศจุดหมายปัจจุบันซ้ำด้วย
On. Restarting the beacon also re-speaks.pt: Ligado. Reiniciar a baliza também reanuncia o destino atual.

Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.en: Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings, without speaking.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.ja: オフ。ビーコンを再開しても、読み上げずにピング音だけを鳴らします。
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.fr: Désactivé. Redémarrer la balise relance seulement le signal sonore, sans annonce.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.it: Disattivato. Riavviando il segnale viene solo riprodotto il ping, senza annunci.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.de: Aus. Beim Neustart des Signals ertönt nur erneut der Ping, ohne Ansage.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.es: Desactivado. Reiniciar la baliza solo vuelve a emitir el pitido, sin hablar.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.ko: 꺼짐. 비콘을 다시 시작해도 안내 없이 핑 소리만 다시 울립니다.
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.zht: 關閉。重新啟動信標時只會再次發出提示音，不會播報。
Off. Restarting the beacon only re-pings.zhc: 关闭。重新启动信标时只会再次发出提示音，不会播报。

On. Directional tones play as you approa.en: On. Directional tones play as you approach walls.

On. Directional tones play as you approa.it: Attivato. Toni direzionali suonano quando ti avvicini ai muri.
On. Directional tones play as you approa.de: Ein. Richtungstöne erklingen, wenn du dich Wänden näherst.
On. Directional tones play as you approa.es: Activado. Suenan tonos direccionales al acercarte a las paredes.
On. Directional tones play as you approa.ko: 켜짐. 벽에 가까워지면 방향 신호음이 재생됩니다.

Off. No directional wall feedback..ja: オフ。壁の方向フィードバックはありません。

Off. No directional wall feedback..es: Desactivado. Sin aviso direccional de paredes.
Off. No directional wall feedback..zht: 關閉。沒有牆壁方向提示。
Off. No directional wall feedback..zhc: 关闭。没有墙壁方向提示。

Off. No directional wall feedback..pt: Desligado. Sem aviso direcional de paredes.

On. A click plays for each tile of playe.ja: オン。1マス移動するごとにクリック音が鳴ります。
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.fr: Activé. Un clic retentit à chaque case parcourue.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.it: Attivato. Un clic suona a ogni casella percorsa.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.de: Ein. Bei jedem Feld, das du gehst, ertönt ein Klick.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.es: Activado. Suena un clic por cada casilla que avanzas.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.ko: 켜짐. 한 칸 이동할 때마다 클릭음이 재생됩니다.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.zht: 開啟。每移動一格播放一次點擊聲。
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.zhc: 开启。每移动一格播放一次点击声。
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.ru: Вкл. Щелчок звучит на каждой клетке движения.
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.th: เปิด. เสียงคลิกจะดังทุกครั้งที่เดินหนึ่งช่อง
On. A click plays for each tile of playe.pt: Ligado. Um clique toca a cada casa percorrida.

Off. No per-tile movement sound..zht: 關閉。移動時不播放每格音效。
Off. No per-tile movement sound..zhc: 关闭。移动时不播放每格音效。
Off. No per-tile movement sound..ru: Выкл. Без звука на каждой клетке.
Off. No per-tile movement sound..th: ปิด. ไม่มีเสียงเมื่อเดินแต่ละช่อง
Off. No per-tile movement sound..pt: Desligado. Sem som a cada casa.

On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.en: On. Entity cycling shows only entities reachable via pathfinding.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.ja: オン。エンティティの切り替えでは、経路探索で到達できるものだけを表示します。
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.fr: Activé. Le parcours des entités n'affiche que celles accessibles par un chemin.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.it: Attivato. Lo scorrimento delle entità mostra solo quelle raggiungibili tramite percorso.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.de: Ein. Beim Durchblättern werden nur Objekte angezeigt, die per Wegfindung erreichbar sind.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.es: Activado. Al recorrer las entidades solo se muestran las accesibles por ruta.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.ko: 켜짐. 개체 순환 시 경로 탐색으로 도달 가능한 개체만 표시합니다.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.zht: 開啟。切換實體時只顯示可經由尋路到達的實體。
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.zhc: 开启。切换实体时只显示可经由寻路到达的实体。
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.ru: Вкл. При переборе объектов показываются только доступные по маршруту.
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.th: เปิด. การวนดูสิ่งของจะแสดงเฉพาะสิ่งที่เดินไปถึงได้
On. Entity cycling shows only entities r.pt: Ligado. Ao percorrer as entidades, só aparecem as alcançáveis por caminho.

Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.en: Off. All entities appear when cycling, including unreachable ones.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.ja: オフ。到達できないものも含め、すべてのエンティティを表示します。
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.fr: Désactivé. Toutes les entités apparaissent, y compris celles inaccessibles.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.it: Disattivato. Compaiono tutte le entità, anche quelle irraggiungibili.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.de: Aus. Alle Objekte werden angezeigt, auch unerreichbare.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.es: Desactivado. Aparecen todas las entidades, incluso las inaccesibles.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.ko: 꺼짐. 도달할 수 없는 개체를 포함해 모든 개체가 표시됩니다.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.zht: 關閉。切換時會顯示所有實體，包括無法到達的。
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.zhc: 关闭。切换时会显示所有实体，包括无法到达的。
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.ru: Выкл. При переборе показываются все объекты, включая недоступные.
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.th: ปิด. แสดงสิ่งของทั้งหมดเมื่อวนดู รวมถึงสิ่งที่เดินไปไม่ถึง
Off. All entities appear when cycling, i.pt: Desligado. Todas as entidades aparecem, inclusive as inalcançáveis.

On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.en: On. Multiple exits leading to the same destination collapse to the closest one.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.ja: オン。同じ行き先への複数の出口は、最も近いもの1つにまとめます。
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.fr: Activé. Les sorties menant à la même destination sont regroupées en la plus proche.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.it: Attivato. Le uscite verso la stessa destinazione vengono unite nella più vicina.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.de: Ein. Mehrere Ausgänge zum selben Ziel werden zum nächstgelegenen zusammengefasst.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.es: Activado. Las salidas que llevan al mismo destino se agrupan en la más cercana.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.ko: 켜짐. 같은 목적지로 가는 여러 출구를 가장 가까운 하나로 합칩니다.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.zht: 開啟。通往相同目的地的多個出口會合併為最近的一個。
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.zhc: 开启。通往相同目的地的多个出口会合并为最近的一个。
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.ru: Вкл. Несколько выходов в одно место объединяются в ближайший.
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.th: เปิด. ทางออกหลายทางที่ไปยังจุดหมายเดียวกันจะรวมเหลือทางที่ใกล้ที่สุด
On. Multiple exits leading to the same d.pt: Ligado. Várias saídas para o mesmo destino são agrupadas na mais próxima.
